name: Hash
description: Compute MD5, SHA, SM3 and CRC32 digests and HMACs of text and files; large files run as tasks with live logs; create checksum manifests for folders and verify them in bulk
help: Text digests and HMACs update as you type; file hashing runs as a background task you can cancel and review in the task center.
HMAC keys can be entered as text, hex or Base64, and a pasted MAC is checked in constant time.
Each file is read once while every selected algorithm is computed.
Drag files onto the window to add them.
Everything runs in the local Rust engine; file contents never leave your machine.

Manifest: create sha256sum / md5sum compatible checksum manifests for a folder, or import a manifest (GNU or BSD style) and verify every entry in parallel in the background, marking OK / FAILED / MISSING. Large files are read in chunks.
